question: the R20->R10 cadence gap was measured on books that all start in one winter; once start dates spread out, is the gap a property of the entry date or of the market segment the book happens to live in?

rule.R1_starts: six quarterly start dates 2021-09-01..2024-03-01, deliberately outside the 2020 winter; a book shorter than 2 quarters is named, never zeroed
rule.R2_same_grid: every book is cut on the same calendar quarters, so two books differ only in entry date inside a quarter and one book differs only in market across quarters -- that is what makes the two channels separable at all
rule.R3_pair: inside a quarter a delta pairs the SAME bar grid, cost, n_hold and start; only the cadence differs
rule.R4_polish: two-way median polish, 9 sweeps, on the (start x segment) delta grid; row effect = start-date channel, column effect = regime channel, residual = the interaction neither explains
rule.R5_verdict: compare the interquartile spread of the row effects with that of the column effects; a ratio >= 2.0 names a winner, anything less is MIXED
rule.R6_thin: a quarter needs >= 2 live books to be used for the path channel, and a book needs >= 3 readable quarters to be used for the regime channel; every excluded cell is named in holes
rule.R7_money: money lines use a 1000000 reference account
rule.frozen: thresholds written before the first read of these panels in this round

money.note: the two spreads are per-quarter total-return gaps, not annualised; they size how much the quarter's answer moves, they do not add up to an annual return

desk_sentence: 把 6 个起跑日（2021-09..2024-03，全在 2020 冬天之外）切成同一批日历季度后：同一季度里换起跑日，节奏差的中位四分位极差 1.73 pp（11 个可用季度）；同一本书换季度，极差 4.45 pp（6 本可用书）→ REGIME_DOMINATES | BOTH_CHANNELS_READ。双因素中位抛光后行（起跑日）效应极差 1.22 pp、列（行情段）效应极差 4.54 pp、残差 2.37 pp。
honest: survivorship: the on-disk panel holds ETFs that still exist (family caveat)
no vol target: fast_next_open has none, so these are un-targeted books
a quarter with only two live books gives a thin path reading; quarters with one book are named in channels.excluded_thin_segments and never read as zero spread

path and regime channels are not independent samples: the path channel is a portfolio-sort difference inside one market, the regime channel is a market difference for one sort; the polish residual is the part neither explains
start dates were chosen to leave the 2020 winter out, so this face says nothing about how that winter's reading behaves
quarter returns are total returns inside a quarter, not annualised; they size the movement of the answer, they do not sum to an annual number
